LanguageData.MFV_SuppressVanillaTechResearchTooltip: Hide vanilla technology research and prevent colonies from starting it.
LanguageData.MFV_SuppressVanillaTechResearchDescripti: When enabled, Electricity, Microelectronics, Multi-Analyzer, and vanilla research that depends on them are hidden from the vanilla research tree.
LanguageData.MFV_ShowTechDisabledWarningTooltip: Show a reminder when a game starts with vanilla tech research suppressed.
LanguageData.MFV_ShowTechDisabledWarningDescription: Shows a reminder when tech research suppression is active.
LanguageData.MFV_ShowDevModeSpellGizmosTooltip: Show Magic Framework spell testing gizmos on eligible pawns while dev mode is active.
LanguageData.MFV_ShowDevModeSpellGizmosDescription: When disabled, dev mode stays available but the large set of spell testing gizmos is hidden.
LanguageData.MFV_ShowLeylineStrengthNumbersTooltip: Show numeric leyline power values on visible cells while the leyline overlay is active and the camera is zoomed in.
LanguageData.MFV_ShowLeylineStrengthNumbersDescriptio: When enabled, leyline cells show their raw strength values at close zoom. This is mainly useful for tuning and precise placement.
